purpose: Prospective read-only candidate sampler-score arithmetic diagnostic; no task, grader, optimizer or held-out access.
prompt_prefix: Numerical probability calibration text. A sequence of colors follows.
observation: A neutral observation: orange and violet. Continue ordinary text.
outcome_rule: Pass each measured arm only if both complete groups satisfy the unchanged differentiated 1e-6 guard, finite scores, and exact pre/post full parameter hashes. Baseline ordinary-forward differences on identical recorded tokens are diagnostic only. No training authorization.
limitations: New task-free contexts and seeds; a prospective correctness test, not a paired comparison against the historical v1 cohort.
Only FP32 and BF16 CPU arms are included; q4 v1 timed out and is not reclassified or retried.
No optimizer or capability result; Metal, stale-policy ratios, large-model gradients, and longer contexts are unvalidated.
